name: APLB Glutathione Niacinamide Body Lotion
skinType: All Skin Types / Dull Body Skin
description: Moisturizes the body, improves skin elasticity, enhances skin brightness and radiance, and strengthens the skin barrier.
howToUse: Apply generously to dry areas of the body after cleansing and massage gently until absorbed.

name: Bunny Brightening Acne Serum
description: Brightens the skin, helps reduce acne breakouts, fades post-acne dark spots, and smooths while moisturizing the skin.
howToUse: Dispense 2-3 drops with the precision dropper onto clean skin before applying moisturizer, morning and night.

name: by365 Powdery UV Cream - No Color
description: Provides daily sun and UV water resistance. The clear white tone-up formula visually brightens the complexion, softens the look of uneven texture, and maintains moisture without added fragrances.
howToUse: Apply evenly across face and neck 15 minutes before stepping into the sun. Reapply as needed.

name: Centellian24 Madeca Cream Time Reverse Zero
description: A fragrance-free, anti-aging dermatological cream formulated specifically for sensitive skin. It visibly smooths fine lines, firms the skin, calms reactive areas, and repairs the skin barrier without causing irritation.
howToUse: Smooth a moderate amount over face and neck morning and night to calm and repair the protective barrier.

name: Medicube Zero Pore Blackhead Mud Mask
description: A 3-minute quick-dry mask that exfoliates, unclogs pores, visibly reduces blackheads, and controls excess sebum while providing a soothing cooling effect.
howToUse: Apply an even layer over clean skin. Let dry for 3 minutes, then rinse off thoroughly with lukewarm water.

name: Numbuzin No. 5 Mask
description: Brightens the complexion, provides a glowing effect, hydrates, and offers soothing and anti-acne properties.
howToUse: Place the sheet mask onto cleansed face for 10-20 minutes. Discard sheet and pat remaining essence into skin.

name: Senka Perfect Whip
description: A micro-beauty foam cleanser that effectively removes impurities while helping the skin maintain its protective moisture barrier.
howToUse: Dispense a pea-sized amount, lather with water to create dense micro-foam, massage onto face, and rinse.

name: numbuzin No. 1 Clear Filter Sun Essence SPF50+ PA++++
ingredients: Licorice Root Water, Centella Asiatica Extract, Heartleaf Extract, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid
description: A lightweight, watery chemical sun essence offering SPF50+ PA++++ broad-spectrum protection. Infused with calming herb extracts to cool heated skin, reduce redness, and hydrate without feeling greasy or leaving a white cast.
howToUse: Apply an adequate amount evenly over face and neck as the last step of your morning skincare routine. Gently pat until fully absorbed, and reapply every 2 hours during prolonged outdoor exposure.

name: UNOVE No-Wash Water Ampoule Treatment (Tender Bloom)
skinType: Damaged, Dry, Tangled, Frizzy, Permed or Colored Hair
ingredients: Hydrolyzed Silk, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Amino Acids Complex, Camellia Japonica Seed Oil, Argan Kernel Oil, Olive Fruit Oil
description: A leave-in water ampoule spray packed with protein and amino acid nutrients to instantly detangle unruly strands, smooth split ends, and soften coarse, heat-damaged hair with a lightweight, non-sticky finish and floral-musk scent.
howToUse: After towel-drying hair, spray evenly from a distance of 10–15 cm onto damp lengths and ends, then proceed with blow-drying or styling. Can also be applied lightly to dry hair to tame frizz.

name: Treecell Anti Dandruff Shampoo Ocean Breeze
skinType: Flaky Scalp, Itchy Scalp, Oily Roots, Sensitive Scalp
ingredients: Dandclean™ Complex, Salicylic Acid, Panthenol, Menthol, Centella Asiatica Extract, Hyaluronic Acid
description: A scalp-purifying anti-dandruff shampoo formulated with patented Dandclean™ to eliminate visible flakes, alleviate persistent itching, and wash away excess sebum with a crisp ocean breeze cooling sensation.
howToUse: Wet hair and scalp thoroughly with lukewarm water. Pump a moderate amount, massage into the scalp to build a rich cooling lather, leave for 1–2 minutes, and rinse thoroughly.

name: Treecell Night Collagen Shampoo Midnight Forest
skinType: Oily Scalp, Sensitive Scalp, Fine or Thinning Hair, Hair Fall Concerns
ingredients: Hydrolyzed Collagen (254Da), Salicylic Acid, Panthenol, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Leaf Extract, Menthol, Rosemary Leaf Oil
description: A specialized evening scalp care shampoo featuring low-molecular collagen to restore scalp elasticity, remove daily sebum and debris buildup, and calm the senses with a soothing midnight forest botanical fragrance.
howToUse: Best used during night showers. Apply to wet hair and scalp, massage gently to deep-cleanse accumulated grime from the day, and rinse completely with lukewarm water.

name: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo (Morning of Resort)
skinType: Dry Scalp, Coarse Hair, Damaged Hair, Frizzy Strands
ingredients: Hydrolyzed Collagen, Caffeine, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Silk, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Niacinamide
description: A moisture-replenishing morning shampoo packed with collagen and silk proteins that detangles and smooths rough hair strands without needing a heavy separate conditioner, leaving a subtle citrus floral finish.
howToUse: Apply onto wet hair and scalp in the morning. Gently massage into a silky lather to soften and nourish lengths and roots, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water..

name: ANESSA Brightening UV Sunscreen Gel Tone Up
skinType: Dull skin, Uneven skin tone, Normal to Dry
ingredients: Tranexamic Acid, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Leaf Extract, Tormentilla Root Extract, Sodium Hyaluronate, Soluble Collagen
description: A hydrating gel sunscreen offering SPF50+ PA++++ broad-spectrum defense infused with Tranexamic Acid to curb melanin formation and fade dark spots. Features a sheer lavender-pink tint that instantly corrects dullness and imparts a natural translucent glow.
howToUse: Apply generously and evenly onto the face and neck as the final step of your morning skincare routine or as a brightening makeup primer base. Reapply after heavy sweating or toweling.

name: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle First Spray Serum
ingredients: Italian Whiteves skin texture Truffle Extract (Tuber Magnatum), Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Avocado Oil, Sunflower Seed Oil, Niacinamide, Bifida Ferment Lysate
description: A bi-phase glowing mist combining a nourishing plant oil layer and a deeply hydrating serum layer enriched with Italian white truffle to deliver instant hydration, anti-aging elasticity, and a luminous glass-skin radiance without feeling sticky.
howToUse: Shake well 3 to 5 times to thoroughly blend the oil and serum layers. Close eyes, hold 10–20 cm away from the face, and spritz evenly whenever skin feels dry, immediately after cleansing as a first-step serum, or over makeup for a dewy finish..

name: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Cleanser
ingredients: Deep Sea Water, Glycerin, Panthenol, Allantoin, Ceramide NP, Triple Hyaluronic Acid
description: A gentle, slightly acidic foaming cleanser that creates a dense micro-bubble lather to remove ultra-fine dust, excess oil, and impurities without stripping natural moisture.
howToUse: Squeeze a small amount onto clean, wet palms and work into a rich foam with water. Gently massage across the face in circular motions, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

name: B.LAB Perfect Balance 8:2 Matcha Hydrating Foam Cleanser
ingredients: Camellia Sinensis (Matcha) Leaf Extract, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Powder, Centella Asiatica Extract, Hyaluronic Acid, Coconut-Derived Surfactants
description: A gentle, pH-balanced foaming cleanser infused with antioxidant-rich matcha green tea and centella asiatica to clear sebum and impurities without stripping moisture.
howToUse: Squeeze a moderate amount onto clean, wet palms and work into a rich foam with water. Gently massage across damp skin in circular motions, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

name: COSRX Ultra-Light Invisible Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++
ingredients: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Water, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Leaf Water, Sodium Hyaluronate, Niacinamide, Tocopherol, Allantoin
description: An ultra-lightweight, invisible chemical sunscreen that absorbs quickly with zero white cast, providing daily UV defense and refreshing hydration.
howToUse: Apply evenly to the face and neck 15 minutes before sun exposure as the final step of your morning skincare routine. Reapply every 2 hours as needed.

name: iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream
ingredients: Centella Asiatica Leaf Water (72%), Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Water (10%), Niacinamide, Adenosine, Allantoin
description: A refreshing, oil-free gel cream enriched with centella asiatica and tea tree leaf water to soothe irritation, blemishes, and redness while keeping skin hydrated.
howToUse: After cleansing and toning, take an appropriate amount and smooth evenly over the face and neck, gently tapping until fully absorbed.

name: Judydoll Liquid Contour & Under Eye Brightening Duo - #01 Fair With Cool Undertones
ingredients: Dimethicone, Isododecane, Silica, Mica, Titanium Dioxide, Iron Oxides
description: A dual-ended liquid contour and brightening wand with a cool grayish-brown contour shade to sculpt natural shadows and a cool-toned brightener to lift dull under-eyes.
howToUse: Dab the contour tip along cheekbones, jawline, and nose sides, then blend smoothly. Dot the brightening applicator under the eyes and pat lightly to set.

name: Judydoll Liquid Contour & Under Eye Brightening Duo - #02 Fair With Warm Undertones
ingredients: Dimethicone, Isododecane, Silica, Mica, Titanium Dioxide, Iron Oxides
description: A 2-in-1 dual-ended liquid contour and concealer featuring a warm brown shading wand to add natural depth and a warm beige brightener to neutralize dark circles.
howToUse: Apply the contour wand along the hairline and nose contour to blend seamlessly. Dot the brightening wand under the eyes and high points of the face to illuminate.

name: rejuran nutritive cream c-pdrn 0.2
ingredients: Hydrolyzed DNA (c-PDRN 0.2%), Glycerin, Shea Butter, Niacinamide, Ceramide NP, Adenosine, Jojoba Seed Oil
description: A rich nutritive barrier cream formulated with c-PDRN to strengthen stressed skin protection, deeply nourish, and improve skin elasticity.
howToUse: Apply an appropriate amount evenly across the face and neck morning and night as the final step of your skincare routine, gently pressing for absorption.

name: REJURAN Skin Protection Mask
skinType: All Skin Types, Tired, Stressed, Sensitive Skin
ingredients: Hydrolyzed DNA (c-PDRN), Water, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Centella Asiatica Extract, Sodium Hyaluronate, Adenosine
description: A premium care sheet mask enriched with c-PDRN that transforms tired, stressed skin from external environmental aggressors into a moist, healthy condition.
howToUse: After cleansing and toning, place the sheet mask evenly over the face. Leave on for 10-20 minutes, then remove and gently pat remaining essence into the skin.

name: REJURAN Turnover Ampoule c-PDRN 0.5%
skinType: All Skin Types, Aging, Dull, Sensitive Skin
ingredients: Rubus Fruticosus (Blackberry) Leaf Extract, Hydrolyzed DNA (c-PDRN 0.5%), Glycerin, Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Adenosine
description: A premium anti-aging turnover ampoule formulated with high-concentration c-PDRN to accelerate natural renewal, refine texture, and restore firmness.
howToUse: After toning, dispense a moderate amount using the dropper and smooth evenly across the face and neck, lightly tapping until fully absorbed.

name: weYOUNG Brightening Cleansing Water
skinType: All Skin Types, Dull, Sensitive Skin
ingredients: Water, Dipropylene Glycol, PEG-6 Caprylic/Capric Glycerides, Niacinamide, Citrus Limon (Lemon) Fruit Extract, Panthenol, Centella Asiatica Extract
description: A gentle micellar cleansing water that thoroughly lifts makeup, sunscreen, and daily impurities while brightening and refreshing the complexion.
howToUse: Soak a cotton pad thoroughly and gently wipe across the face from center outwards. For stubborn makeup, hold the pad over the area for 5-10 seconds before wiping away.

name: weYOUNG Premium Cotton Pad
ingredients: 100% Pure Natural Cotton, Lint-Free Sealed Edges
description: Ultra-soft, lint-free multi-layer cotton pads designed for gentle cleansing water and toner application without absorbing excess product.
howToUse: Dispense cleansing water or toner onto the cotton pad and sweep smoothly across the skin, or split to use as a targeted toner pack.

name: Anua Heartleaf 70 Soothing Collagen Mask
description: A color-changing hydrogel sheet mask infused with 70% heartleaf water and low-molecular collagen to deeply hydrate, calm redness, and improve skin elasticity and smoothness.
howToUse: After cleansing and toning, remove the films from the upper and lower mask pieces and apply them evenly to your face. Leave on for 3 to 4 hours (or overnight) until the mask turns transparent, then remove and gently pat the remaining essence into the skin.

name: Purito SEOUL Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream
skinType: All Skin Types, Dry Skin, Sensitive Skin
description: A lightweight, fast-absorbing barrier-repair moisturizer formulated with 10% panthenol and Korean bamboo extract to lock in moisture, calm irritation, and deliver a non-greasy dewy finish.
howToUse: Take an appropriate amount as the final step of your skincare routine and apply evenly to the face and neck, patting gently to aid absorption.

name: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
skinType: All Skin Types, Dry Skin, Sensitive Skin
description: A hydrating chemical sunscreen with SPF50+ PA++++ broad-spectrum UV protection enriched with birch sap and hyaluronic acid that blends seamlessly with no white cast.
howToUse: Apply liberally and evenly across the face and neck as the final step of your morning skincare routine, 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2 hours when outdoors.

name: The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution
skinType: Normal Skin, Oily Skin, Combination Skin
description: A water-based exfoliating toner formulated with 7% alpha-hydroxy acid (AHA) to gently buff away dead skin cells, refine rough texture, and promote visibly brighter, more even-toned skin.
howToUse: Use once daily, ideally in the evening. After cleansing, saturate a cotton pad with the formula and sweep across the face and neck, avoiding the eye contour. Do not rinse off, and always wear sunscreen during the day.
